steps.say: Move the {arm} gripper very slowly to a position just above the edge of the white plastic bag lying on the green table.
Lower the {arm} gripper very slowly to the table at the edge of the white plastic bag, so that one finger slides under the edge of the bag along the table and the other finger stays above the bag.
Close the {arm} gripper slowly to pinch the edge of the white plastic bag between the finger below it and the finger above it.
Lift the white plastic bag very slowly 10 centimeters up with the {arm} gripper, keeping it pinched.
Move the white plastic bag very slowly over the taped square marked {zone} and hold it there.
